question: Which mantra sequence and goddess protect the pair of breasts?
premises: The sequence śrīṃ hrīṃ strīṃ hūṃ phaṭ is invoked.
The auspicious Tārā is named as protector.
The pair of breasts is the body part to be protected.
inference: Auspicious Tārā with the mantra śrīṃ hrīṃ strīṃ hūṃ phaṭ is invoked to protect the breasts.
plain_english: May śrīṃ, hrīṃ, strīṃ, hūṃ, and phaṭ, as auspicious Tārā, protect my pair of breasts.
